name: charts-design
description: McKinsey-grade executive charts, KPI metric cards, interactive pivot tables, and dashboard generator. 麦肯锡风格图表设计与高管决策看板套件。

scripts.test: node bin/python-runtime.js -m pytest tests --ignore=tests/runtime -q && node bin/python-runtime.js -m pytest tests/runtime -q && node --test tests/runtime/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node bin/python-runtime.js -m pytest tests/runtime -q -m "not browser" && node --test tests/runtime/*.test.mjs && node bin/python-runtime.js -m pytest tests --ignore=tests/runtime -q
scripts.test:container: docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile -t charts-design:local . && python3 tests/deploy/container_smoke.py --image charts-design:local
scripts.check: npm run check:skills && npm run check:docs && node --check bin/check-doc-links.js && node --check bin/cli.js && node --check bin/python-runtime.js && node --check bin/mcp-runtime.js && node --check bin/dashboard-runtime.js && node bin/python-runtime.js -m py_compile skills/executive-charts/scripts/dashboard_workspace.py skills/executive-charts/scripts/generate_dashboard.py skills/executive-charts/scripts/core/*.py tests/deploy/container_smoke.py
scripts.runtime:build: npm --prefix runtime-ui install && npm --prefix runtime-ui run build
scripts.runtime:test: node bin/python-runtime.js -m pytest tests/runtime -q && node --test tests/runtime/*.test.mjs
